references.text: Isaiah invites all who thirst to come and drink water without cost, an image of the spiritual longing that Jesus fulfills by inviting the thirsty to himself.
Here, water is drawn from wells with joy, an image of the joy of salvation and the living stream of water that Jesus promises to those who come to him.
Ezekiel sees water flowing out from the temple giving life, a direct image of the living stream of water that Jesus promises will flow from those who believe in him.
Revelation repeats the theme with an invitation to the thirsty, where the Spirit and the bride say: "Come!", and whoever wishes may take the water of life freely.
